policy: explicit user consensus: dual modality inconsistency = binary NoFire
threshold_source: transparent configurable engineering defaults; user gave no numeric threshold; no UV test tuning
sensitivity_rule: tau_l=tau_h/3, frozen before all metrics, diagnostic only; nominal remains 0.3
decision: matched and polygon_iou>=tau_h and BetP(F)>0.5; missing/no overlap/below or equal tau_l = NoFire; tau_l<s<tau_h = Transition binary NoFire
candidate_selection: Hungarian maximum total polygon IoU, then max IoU candidate, tie visual BetP, min confidence, deterministic candidate index; never UV-conditioned
multi_box_aggregation: single maximum-IoU candidate, never correlated mass summation
temperature_policy: Tmax retained; physical unit/calibration unknown, no new temperature threshold
model_predictions: reuse genuine cached supplied YOLO26n class fire score>0.5; no reinference or retraining
